card.title: Shared clipboard
card.off: It’s turned off in the server options.
card.server: Text and images up to {limit} MB · change it in the server options.
card.client: The server decides whether it’s shared and up to what size.
preview.label: Show the text
preview.hint: Shows the beginning of the copied text. It only appears in this window and isn’t saved.
hidden: Text hidden: preview is turned off.
empty.running: Nothing has gone through the clipboard yet. Copy text, an image or files on any of the computers.
empty.stopped: Once Deskflow is running, you’ll see here what gets copied between the computers.
sent.client: Sent to the server; you can now paste it on the others.
received.detail: You can paste it here now.
shared.from: You can paste it here and on the others now.
note.dropped: Shared without {what}: it didn’t fit within the {limit} MB limit.
skipped.tooLarge.title: Not shared: it’s too large
skipped.tooLarge.detail: Not even the text fits within the {limit} MB limit.
skipped.tooLarge.server: You can raise it in the server options.
skipped.detail: It has no text, image or files that Deskflow can share.
failed.title: Another program had the clipboard busy
failed.detail: Deskflow tried for 3 seconds and couldn’t. Copy it again.
other.title: Clipboard activity
files.sentTo.title: Sent {files} to {computer}
files.sentTo.detail: You can paste them on {computer} now.
files.sentToServer.detail: Sent to the server; you can now paste them on whichever computer you move to.
files.receivedFrom.title: Received {files} from {computer}
files.received.title: Received {files}
files.received.detail: You can paste them here now: Ctrl+V in a folder.
files.sharedFrom.detail: They reached this computer; they go to each one when the cursor enters it.
files.sharedHere.detail: They go to each computer when the cursor enters it.
files.skipped.title: The copied files weren’t shared
files.skipped.tooLarge: They exceed the {limit} MB limit; you can change it below.
files.failedWith.title: Couldn’t copy {files} with {computer}
files.failedWithAll.title: Couldn’t copy the files with {computer}
files.failed.title: Couldn’t copy the files
files.fail.tooLarge: They exceed the size limit ({limit} MB here; the other computer has its own).
files.fail.noUser: Nobody is signed in on the other computer.
files.fail.changed: A file changed or was deleted while it was being sent. Copy it again.
files.fail.damaged: A file arrived damaged, so the whole copy was discarded. Copy again.
files.fail.diskFull: There’s no room on the disk to receive them.
files.fail.refused: The other computer doesn’t accept files: its shared clipboard or file copying is turned off.
files.fail.superseded: Something else was copied in the meantime.
files.limitLabel: Maximum size of a file copy, in MB
files.note: Each computer decides this, for what it sends and what it receives. It takes effect the next time Deskflow starts.
progress.keepWorking: {progress} · you can keep using the keyboard and mouse.
